title: WeightBench v0: two small instruction models at chance on five weight-reading tasks
read_level: partial (no paper PDF exists; record is a Zenodo 'Dataset'. Read record page, RESULT.md, TASKS.md, gen.py/harness.py headers, and both results JSONL files (per-cell pass counts recomputed and match RESULT.md); LEADERBOARD.md and tasks.sha256 downloads failed)
metadata_mismatch: Corpus id 24047726 resolves to version record 24047727 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24047727). Otherwise title, author, date match.
why_wsp: Pre-registered mini-benchmark asking small open LLMs (Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct) to read compressed weight summaries of small MLPs/PPO nets and answer 4-way questions (game, dataset, activation, trained vs random, which net is better), with a value-shuffled control arm.
domain: weight reading of small MLP classifiers (MNIST/FashionMNIST/CIFAR-gray) and PPO game policies
target: 2-layer MLPs 784->16->10 (T2-T5); 4 PPO game nets from RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs exp1 (T1)
interface: other (compressed numeric summary of weights in prompt; forced-choice letter-logit scoring, no tools, no chain of thought)

headline_results.claim: All model x task cells fail the pre-registered rule
headline_results.quote: All 10 model x task cells are FAIL (chance 25%, n=24 each, 4-way forced choice, deterministic letter-logit scoring)
Control matches main within noise for both models, so neither reads the weights; best cell (1.5B T2, 9/24) is below the 12/24 bar. 7B is not better than 1.5B.

cost.quote: 7B ran bf16 on GPU (about 48 s per trial because VRAM was nearly full)

baselines_and_controls: value-shuffled weight summaries (same prompt, values permuted); 25% chance; pre-registered PASS/FAIL thresholds
runs_and_variance: n=24 instances per cell, deterministic scoring, single run; 'n=24 per cell with correlated instances (shared training procedure), so +-10 points of noise' (RESULT.md)
verification: none (pre-registration with task-file SHA in tasks.sha256)
memorization_vs_reasoning: Main arm equals shuffled-control arm, read by author as no weight reading at this scale/format.
limitations_stated: Lossy compressed summaries (signal may be unrecoverable by design); one prompt template, no CoT or tools; T2 has never-correct distractor and T5 labels unbalanced; two small models only; 'no frontier model was tested, so nothing here bears on the source post's claim'; mixed CPU/GPU and dtype provenance.
code_or_data: https://zenodo.org/records/24047727 (gen.py, harness.py, leaderboard.py, TASKS.md, RESULT.md, LEADERBOARD.md, per-model results JSONL, tasks.sha256)
cites_or_builds_on: RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs (Takehi et al. 2026 logs) exp1 PPO nets
replication_w1 (author's own prior replication, referenced in TASKS.md)
notes_for_survey: A small pre-registered null result for B1 reading: 1.5B and 7B Qwen models score at chance and equal to the shuffled control on compressed weight summaries. Its main reusable contribution is the harness and shuffled-control design; it does not test frontier models or raw weights.
